blocks.text: Cell signalling cells ki woh salahiyat (ability) hai ke woh apne mahol (environment) ke muharrikat (stimuli) ka jawab de kar cellular responses paida karen. Is mein molecular waqiat (events) ke ek silsile ke zariye cells ke darmiyan signals ki tarseel (transmission) shamil hai, jo aksar ek cellular response tak le jati hai.

blocks.title: Cell signalling
blocks.text: Cells ki apne mahol ke muharrikat ka jawab cellular responses paida kar ke dene ki salahiyat, molecular waqiat ke silsile mein cells ke darmiyan bheje gaye signals ke zariye.

items: Signal reception: cell signalling tab shuru hoti hai jab ek signal molecule (ligand) target cell ki membrane par ek receptor se jurta hai. Receptors aam taur par cell membrane mein jare proteins hain magar cell ke andar bhi ho sakte hain. Har receptor ek khaas ligand ke liye makhsoos hai.

Signal transduction: jab receptor ligand se jurta hai to us ki shakal badalti hai (conformational change) jo cell ke andar ek signalling pathway ko faal (activate) karti hai. Is mein aksar taalluqat aur tabdeeliyon ka ek silsila hota hai jo signalling cascade banata hai aur signal ko barha (amplify) deta hai. Chhote molecules jaise cAMP (cyclic AMP), calcium ions aur inositol triphosphate (IP3) second messengers ka kaam karte hain, jo signal ko receptor se cell ke andar target molecules tak pohanchate hain.

Cellular response: signal transduction pathway aksar gene expression mein tabdeeli lati hai, khaas genes ko on ya off kar ke. Is se cell ki numu (growth), taqseem (division), differentiation ya apoptosis (programmed cell death) ho sakti hai. Signalling cell ke metabolism, enzyme ki sargarmi, ya ion channels ke khulne aur band hone mein bhi tabdeeli la sakti hai.

blocks.text: Cell signals ke bahar se andar ke raste (pathways)
Cell signalling pathways signals ko cell ke bahar se andar pohanchati hain, jis se ek khaas cellular response hota hai. Signalling molecule ki qisam ki bunyad par pathway ki do bari qismein hain.

Protein ya peptide signalling molecules pani mein hal hone wale (water-soluble) hain, is liye plasma membrane se nahin guzar sakte. Jab aisa ligand cell ki satah ke qareeb aata hai to plasma membrane par apne makhsoos receptor se jurta hai. Yeh jurna receptor protein ki shakal badalta aur use faal karta hai. Faal receptor cell ke andar reactions ka ek silsila shuru karta hai jo cyclic AMP (cAMP) jaisa second messenger banata hai, jo gene expression mein tabdeeli jaisi tabdeeliyan shuru karta hai. Yeh pathway metabolism, cell ki numu, taqseem ya apoptosis mein tabdeeli la sakti hai.

Steroid hormones, lipid-pasand (lipophilic) hone ki wajah se, target cell ki plasma membrane se diffuse ho kar guzar sakte hain. Andar aa kar yeh cytoplasm ya nucleus mein maujood makhsoos intracellular receptors se jurte hain. Is jurne se faal receptor-hormone complex banta hai, jo nucleus mein chala jata hai agar pehle se wahan na ho. Nucleus ke andar yeh complex target genes mein khaas DNA sequences se jurta hai aur un ki transcription qaboo karta hai, jis se khaas proteins ki paidawar barhti ya ghat-ti hai.

blocks.alt: Do cells saath-saath. Baen: pani mein hal hone wala ligand plasma membrane mein receptor se jurta hai (reception); second messengers ka shakhdar cascade signal ko barhata hai (transduction); teer nucleus mein jata hai jahan genes on ya off hote hain (response). Daen: steroid hormone membrane se seedha diffuse hota hai, intracellular receptor se jurta hai, aur receptor-hormone complex nucleus mein ja kar DNA se jurta hai.
blocks.caption: Protein/peptide signalling ka steroid signalling se muqabla (Figures 3.31 se 3.33 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Protein ya peptide signalling mein ligand membrane paar nahin kar sakta, is liye membrane receptor se jurta hai; receptor shakal badalta hai, cAMP, calcium ions aur IP3 jaise second messengers cell ke andar signal barhate hain, aur response gene expression, metabolism, numu, taqseem, differentiation ya apoptosis mein tabdeeli hai. Steroid signalling mein lipid mein hal hone wala hormone bilayer se diffuse hota hai, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein receptor se jurta hai, aur receptor-hormone complex khaas DNA sequences se jur kar target genes ki transcription barhata ya ghatata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek signalling molecule lipid mein hal hone wala hai, jaise steroid hormone. Target cell mein us ke kaam karne ka sab se mumkin tareeqa kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh plasma membrane se diffuse hota hai, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein intracellular receptor se jurta hai, aur receptor-hormone complex khaas DNA sequences se jur kar transcription qaboo karta hai. Use membrane receptor ya second messengers ki zaroorat nahin.

items: Cell signalling: reception (ligand makhsoos receptor se jurta hai), transduction (receptor shakal badalta hai; cAMP, calcium ions aur IP3 jaise second messengers wala cascade signal barhata hai) aur response (genes on ya off; numu, taqseem, differentiation, apoptosis, metabolism, ion channels).
Protein/peptide signals pani mein hal hone wale hain aur membrane receptors aur second messengers ke zariye kaam karte hain.
Steroid signals lipophilic hain, membrane se diffuse hote hain, intracellular receptors se jurte hain, aur complex nucleus mein transcription qaboo karta hai.
